subject: Split-session proposal: security + procurement added — options for new slots
messages:
From: Sarah Miller <sarah.miller@atlasmed.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Marcus Green <m.green@atlasmed.com>, procurement@atlasmed.com
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo — adding security & procurement leads

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on scheduling. We want to expand the attendee list on our side — our security architect (Marcus) and a procurement representative (procurement@atlasmed.com) need to attend to review controls and procurement path. Apologies for the late notice; both are only available the week of Apr 12 and then again Apr 26–28.

A few constraints on our end:
- Marcus is traveling Apr 5–9 (unavailable) but local Apr 12 in the morning PT.
- Procurement prefers afternoons PT or can join Apr 26–28 in the first half of the day.

If possible, can we either:
1) keep the existing product demo on Apr 5 for the PM/engineering audience and schedule a separate 45–60 minute security/procurement session the week of Apr 12; or
2) move the demo to Apr 26 and have everyone attend in a single session (if Redwood can extend to 90 minutes)?

Let me know what works — we want the security checklist to be reviewed live (key questions: data retention, VPC/private deployment options, audit logs).

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Miller
Director of IT Programs
Atlas Medical

Subject: Re: Split-session proposal: quick options

Thanks Sarah — totally understood and appreciate the constraints. We can do either option; short guidance below and a proposed plan: 

Recommendation (to keep time-to-value and avoid forcing a 90-minute group): split the engagement into two linked sessions:

A) Product walkthrough (40 min): high-level flow, integration points, and performance profile — keep for Apr 5 as planned. Audience: PMs, Eng.
B) Security & procurement deep-dive (60 min): controls, architecture, compliance artifacts, pricing/contract path — schedule week of Apr 12 or Apr 26 depending on Atlas availability. Audience: Security, Procurement, Infra.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Product: Apr 5, 10:00–10:40 AM PT (existing invite) — we hold this and keep materials lean.
- Security/procurement: Apr 12, 9:00–10:00 AM PT OR Apr 27, 11:00 AM–12:00 PM PT (we can do either; 27th gives more breathing room).

I'll loop in Marissa to check capacity for a 60-min deep-dive and Rishi for the compliance artifacts. If you prefer a single 90-min session, we can propose Apr 27 10:30–12:00 PM PT as a combined option.

Action: please reply with preferred security slot (Apr 12 morning vs Apr 27 mid) and whether procurement needs any pre-read.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-demo-onepager.pdf (link in Drive)

Quick notes — internal only:
- I can cover product flow on Apr 5 (10:00). Confirmed.
- For security/procurement deep-dive, we should bring:
  * SOC2 scope and current attestation (summary slide)
  * network/VPC options & diagram (7 min)
  * data retention and log export options (5 min)
  * pricing/contract path (procurement-focused slide)
- Rishi, will you own the compliance artifacts? Dev, can you pull the VPC diagram and a short latency/cost slide?

If Atlas wants a combined 90-min session, we need to add 15 min buffer and a separate facilitator for procurement pricing so the product demo doesn’t get diluted. Otherwise, split sessions look cleaner.

-Marissa

I can take point on the compliance pack. I'll attach the CSV inventory of controls and the short SOC2 one-pager. Also: procurement typically wants an MSA redline example and a pricing band — I'll prepare a 2-slide procurement appendix and send a draft to Marissa by EOB Apr 4.

Also note: calendar-wise, Apr 12 morning looks tight for our California-based folks (we have two contra travel) — Apr 27 is safer for staffing. If Atlas absolutely needs Apr 12, we can run the session but may have one subject matter expert remote.

-Rishi

Let's do the split approach: keep the product session on Apr 5 for the PMs, and run a 60-minute security/procurement session on Apr 27 at 11:00 AM PT.
